embedding_text: Condenser vacuum degradation observed. Air removal train differential pressure increased prior to vacuum loss, indicating possible air in-leakage.
Turbine backpressure increased following condenser vacuum degradation.
Work order identified degraded air ejector seals as a likely contributor to air in-leakage.
Standard operating procedure for condenser vacuum degradation includes checking air removal system performance and condenser tube fouling.
HVAC system degradation led to elevated cabinet temperatures affecting instrumentation reliability.
